{"scenes":[{"id":"opening","component":"title_card","props":{"title":"通信噪声如何影响信息传输","subtitle":"发送端通过通信信道把信息传给接收端"},"narration_segment_ids":["n1"],"purpose":"用标题和一句话交代发送端、通信信道、接收端的基本传输关系。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"观众知道传输涉及发送端、通信信道和接收端。","before":"画面空白，尚未出现标题和传输关系。","after":"标题和副标题出现，观众看到发送端通过信道连接接收端。"},"beats":[{"id":"reveal_scene","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"reveal_title","action":"reveal","target_id":"title","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":300}},{"id":"reveal_subtitle","action":"reveal","target_id":"subtitle","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":600}}]},{"id":"channel_path","component":"flow_diagram","props":{"nodes":[{"id":"sender","label":"发送端"},{"id":"channel","label":"通信信道"},{"id":"receiver","label":"接收端"}],"edges":[{"id":"e_send_channel","from":"sender","to":"channel"},{"id":"e_channel_receive","from":"channel","to":"receiver"}],"paths":[{"id":"main_path","edge_ids":["e_send_channel","e_channel_receive"]}]},"narration_segment_ids":["n2"],"purpose":"定义通信噪声是传输过程中对信号产生的干扰，并在信道环节呈现受扰状态。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"观众理解噪声发生在传输过程中，信道可能受到干扰。","before":"发送端、信道、接收端节点和基础边尚未全部出现，路径未启动。","after":"主路径启动，信道到接收端的边被标记为受扰，观众看到噪声干扰的可见状态。"},"beats":[{"id":"reveal_diagram","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"reveal_sender","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:sender","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":200}},{"id":"reveal_channel","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:channel","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":400}},{"id":"reveal_receiver","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:receiver","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":600}},{"id":"reveal_edge_send","action":"reveal","target_id":"edge:e_send_channel","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":800}},{"id":"reveal_edge_recv","action":"reveal","target_id":"edge:e_channel_receive","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":1000}},{"id":"activate_main_path","action":"activate_path","target_id":"path:main_path","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":1200}},{"id":"mark_channel_disrupted","action":"mark_disrupted","target_id":"edge:e_channel_receive","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"end","offset_ms":-200}}]},{"id":"received_diff","component":"comparison","props":{"left":{"label":"发送端发出","items":["发送端发出的信息"]},"right":{"label":"接收端收到","items":["可能与发送端不同"]},"highlights":["噪声影响后，接收端收到的信息可能与发送端不同"]},"narration_segment_ids":["n3"],"purpose":"对比发送端信息与接收端可能收到的信息，说明噪声影响后二者可能不同。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"观众理解接收端收到的信息可能不同于发送端发出的信息。","before":"左侧发送端信息和右侧接收端信息尚未展示。","after":"左右两侧信息显示，差异被强调。"},"beats":[{"id":"reveal_comparison","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"reveal_left","action":"reveal","target_id":"side:left","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"start","offset_ms":200}},{"id":"reveal_right","action":"reveal","target_id":"side:right","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"start","offset_ms":500}},{"id":"emphasize_difference","action":"emphasize_difference","target_id":"diff","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"end","offset_ms":-200}}]},{"id":"error_possible","component":"concept_reveal","props":{"title":"噪声带来差错的可能性","lines":["噪声可能带来差错","但并非每次传输都出错","干扰存在不等于必然出错"]},"narration_segment_ids":["n4"],"purpose":"总结噪声导致差错的可能性，澄清并非每次传输都会出错。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"观众理解噪声可能带来差错，但不是每次传输都出错。","before":"画面未显示关于差错可能性的结论。","after":"标题和要点逐条出现，突出可能而非必然。"},"beats":[{"id":"reveal_concept","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"reveal_concept_title","action":"reveal","target_id":"title","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":200}},{"id":"reveal_line_0","action":"reveal","target_id":"line:0","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":400}},{"id":"reveal_line_1","action":"reveal","target_id":"line:1","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":700}},{"id":"reveal_line_2","action":"reveal","target_id":"line:2","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":1000}},{"id":"highlight_line_2","action":"highlight","target_id":"line:2","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"end","offset_ms":-200}}]}]}
